notablePrerequisites: Audacious Reshapers does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Audacious Reshapers by tapping it and sacrificing Onulet.
When Onulet dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Onulet trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Onulet on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Audacious Reshapers ability, revealing Onulet from the top of your library, then putting it onto the battlefield and dealing 1 damage to you.
When Onulet enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
